reasons: The genuine claim differs from the planted one only in later-event dates, and every date now matches its source. The ten notices are dated 2017-03-29 through 2026-03-24, matching the texts, FR pages and the clause's own list. EO 14144 is dated 2025-01-16 (sec. 9 restates 13694 sec. 1(a), with no deferred effective date) and EO 14306 is dated 2025-06-06 (sec. 3 adds 'foreign person' in 1(a)(ii) and (iii)). The blind review already found that every quoted span matches the held bytes, that identity is confirmed (82 FR 1, December 28, 2016, FR Doc. 2016-31922), and that the 8-clause inventory covers sections 1 to 5 including restated paragraphs (i) to (iii). The Notice of March 24, 2026 continues the EO 13694 emergency beyond April 1, 2026 and names EO 13757. The OFR notes ('Amends: EO 13694'; See EO 14144, 14306 and the 2026 notice) are addressed, and no held instrument revokes the order. The claim treats the inserted provisions as continuing in amended form, following the cited owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md). The claim contains no one-time command left unresolved.
